quotes.name: Elio Perez
quotes.quote: I’ve heard about the Stabilization Fund, and I hope it helps, but I still see empty storefronts and people struggling to keep their businesses open. It feels like we need more than just money—we need real support and community action.

quotes.name: Daniel Cloak
quotes.quote: I've heard about the Stabilization Fund at the bakery - some folks say it's helping, but I still see empty storefronts on my way to work every morning.

quotes.name: Irene Fay
quotes.quote: I heard about the Stabilization Fund at work—some regulars were talking about how it's supposed to help small businesses, but honestly, I haven't noticed much change around here yet.

quotes.name: Darius Clark
quotes.quote: I heard about that fund at the bakery - some folks say it's helping, but I still see empty storefronts on my block. Hard to tell if it's making a real difference yet.

claim: I’ve heard about the Stabilization Fund, and I hope it helps, but I still see empty storefronts and people struggling to keep their businesses open. It feels like we need more than just money—we need real support and community action.
